name: 27530 · Goldsboro, NC
findings: ZIP 27530 (Goldsboro) has 127 nonprofit organizations. 46 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 32 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 27530 (Goldsboro) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
39% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 27530 (Goldsboro) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 62% of the typical level).
